focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體設備、資料中心電力與儲存供應鏈
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductors, data-center power and storage supply chains

throughline.zh: 美國新規涉及東南亞高階晶片與資料中心算力流向，台灣企業同時公布測試設備產能、車用模組收購，以及 SC26 伺服器、儲存與液冷電源展示。
throughline.en: New U.S. controls address advanced chips and overseas compute in Southeast Asia, while Taiwanese firms disclosed test capacity, a camera-module acquisition and SC26 server, storage and liquid-cooled power systems.

text.zh: 美國 BIS 公布新高階晶片輸出及遠端算力管制，涵蓋星馬泰印等市場；公開稿的正式生效日尚待聯邦公報確認。
text.en: BIS released advanced-chip and remote-compute controls naming Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia; the effective date remains unverified in the examined draft.

text.zh: 鴻海擬以 72.41 億日圓收購 Sony 車載相機模組業務，2027 年 4 月前交割仍需主管機關核准。
text.en: Foxconn agreed to pay an initial ¥7.241bn for Sony's automotive camera-module business, with April 2027 closing subject to approvals.

text.zh: 旺矽規劃 2027 年底 MEMS 月產能達 600 萬針，Insertion 3 已送工程機給 3 家客戶，量產驗收尚未完成。
text.en: WinWay targets six million MEMS probe needles per month by end-2027 and has sent Insertion 3 engineering systems to three customers, pending production acceptance.

text.zh: 台積電公布 35 家年度優良供應商，涵蓋晶圓設備、建廠、材料與先進封裝；得獎並未揭露新增合約。
text.en: TSMC named 35 excellent suppliers across tools, construction, materials and advanced packaging, without new contract values.

text.zh: 神雲 SC26 展示 12 台伺服器、96 顆 GPU 的 52U 液冷機櫃，屬展覽配置，尚無具名客戶交付數據。
text.en: MiTAC demonstrated a 52U liquid-cooled rack with 12 servers and 96 GPUs at SC26; customer delivery totals were not disclosed.

title.zh: 美國 BIS 公布高階晶片輸出及遠端算力新規，涵蓋星馬泰印
title.en: US BIS releases advanced-chip and remote-compute controls covering Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia

summary.zh: 美國商務部工業暨安全局（BIS）11 月 16 日公布暫行最終規則，擬對輸往新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼及巴西的特定高階運算晶片增加許可要求，並限制特定海外資料中心向受管制實體提供大規模遠端算力。路透社 11 月 17 日報導星馬泰政府與業界的初步回應；公開規則稿的生效日欄位尚未填入聯邦公報刊登日期，不應自行認定全面生效時點。
summary.en: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security released an interim final rule on November 16 establishing licensing requirements for specified advanced-computing chips shipped to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, together with controls on remote compute supplied by overseas data centers to covered entities. Reuters reported initial regional responses on November 17. The publicly available rule draft still contains a Federal Register effective-date placeholder, so its precise commencement cannot yet be confirmed from that draft.

label.zh: 供應鏈與法規適用範圍

text.zh: BIS 規則針對受《出口管理條例》管轄的特定高階晶片、伺服器及資料中心使用情境，將部分晶片輸往新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼與巴西列為許可對象。對最終收貨人或最終母公司位於美國的情況，規則草稿另列申報條件下的排除，並非所有區域資料中心均受相同限制。
text.en: The BIS rule targets specified advanced chips, servers and data-center end uses under U.S. export regulations. It names Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil for additional destination-based licensing, while describing a reporting-based exclusion for certain U.S.-headquartered end users. Not all regional data-center transactions are treated alike.

text.zh: 新規另針對海外資料中心向特定受管制國家或澳門總部企業提供大量算力的情境，引入許可與客戶盡職調查要求。文件提及 1,200 萬 aggregate TPP 的相關計算門檻，並針對既有服務規定申請過渡程序及商業推薦系統例外。這是特定範圍的技術與用途規範，不能泛指所有雲端服務遭禁止。
text.en: A separate end-use control addresses overseas data centers supplying significant compute to entities headquartered in certain restricted destinations or Macau, with diligence and license requirements. The draft describes a 12-million aggregate-TPP threshold, transitional applications for some existing services and an exception for commercial recommender systems. It does not amount to a blanket ban on cloud computing.

text.zh: 路透社報導馬來西亞官員表示業者須遵守適用規範，新加坡主管機關正在與受影響企業及美方釐清涵蓋範圍。路透引述馬來西亞自 2021 年以來核准約 3,857 億令吉資料中心投資，該數字屬累計核准額，並非本次法規導致的取消或損失。
text.en: Reuters reported Malaysia's position that companies must comply with applicable controls and Singapore's consultation with affected firms and U.S. authorities. The reported RM385.7 billion of Malaysian data-center approvals since 2021 is a cumulative approved-investment figure, not a cancellation attributed to this rule.

text.zh: 公告所附規則版本尚未列聯邦公報正式刊登日，因此確切生效日期與各企業的許可結果待查。各資料中心實際受控晶片數量、申請件數、業務影響與客戶身分未公開。
text.en: The examined draft does not supply a definitive Federal Register publication date. Exact commencement, company-level licensing decisions, affected chip counts, customer identities and operating effects remain unknown.

title.zh: 鴻海簽約以 72.41 億日圓收購 Sony 車載相機模組業務，預計 2027 年 4 月前交割
title.en: Foxconn agrees to acquire Sony's automotive camera-module business for ¥7.241bn, targeting April 2027 closing

summary.zh: 鴻海 11 月 17 日公告，旗下 Rayprus Japan 擬以初始對價 72.41 億日圓收購 Sony Semiconductor Solutions 車載相機模組事業，中央社折算約新台幣 14.5 億元。交易涵蓋特定營運資產、技術與客戶關係，但部分海外生產設備及存貨不在目前交易範圍內，交割仍須完成主管機關核准及契約先決條件。
summary.en: Foxconn announced on November 17 that subsidiary Rayprus Japan agreed to acquire Sony Semiconductor Solutions' automotive camera-module business for an initial ¥7.241 billion, approximately NT$1.45 billion at CNA's reported conversion. The proposed sale covers identified operating assets, technology and customer relationships but excludes some overseas production equipment and inventory. Closing remains subject to regulatory approvals and contract conditions.

text.zh: 車載相機模組由影像感測晶片、光學鏡頭、封裝組裝、測試與電子控制整合，應用包含 ADAS 與車輛感知系統。此次交易是鴻海擬承接 Sony 旗下特定模組業務與客戶服務資源，與晶圓感測器製造業務的整體收購範圍不同。
text.en: Automotive camera modules combine image sensors, optics, assembly, testing and electronic controls for vehicle perception and ADAS. The transaction is for a specified camera-module business and its customer-serving resources, not for Sony's entire image-sensor wafer operation.

text.zh: 11 月 17 日公開訊息指初始交易金額 7,241,000,000 日圓，最終對價可能依合約條款調整。中央社報導目前金額不包含標的事業的部分海外生產設備與存貨，未來如追加購買將另行公告，因此不能以單一數字概括所有可能轉移資產。
text.en: The publicly reported initial consideration is ¥7,241,000,000, subject to contractual adjustment. CNA says some overseas production equipment and inventory fall outside the present scope and would require separate disclosure if later acquired, so the price does not necessarily cover all potential future asset transfers.

text.zh: 鴻海表示預計於 2027 年 4 月底前完成交割，取決於相關國家主管機關核准及合約先決條件。當前已簽署協議，尚未確認交易完成、設備轉移或新增產能。
text.en: Foxconn targets closing before the end of April 2027, subject to government approvals and contractual conditions. The signed agreement is distinct from a completed transfer, qualified production or additional capacity.

text.zh: 實際交割日、調整後交易總價、各地產線設備清單、客戶訂單與驗收進度未公開。
text.en: The closing date, adjusted price, site-level tool lists, customer orders and acceptance milestones remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 旺矽規劃 MEMS 月產能由 350 萬針增至 600 萬針，CPO 工程機已交付 3 家客戶
title.en: WinWay targets 6m MEMS probe needles per month in 2027, with CPO engineering tools sent to three customers

summary.zh: 旺矽 11 月 16 日法說披露，預計 2026 年底 VPC、MEMS 月產能分別達 200 萬針與 350 萬針，2027 年底目標提高至 250 萬針與 600 萬針。Insertion 3 CPO 設備工程機已送交 3 家客戶，而 Insertion 2 的首家客戶驗證結果預計 12 月出爐；新增產能、量產訂單與 2027 年營收成長至少 50% 均屬公司規劃或預測。
summary.en: At its November 16 briefing, WinWay said it expects year-end 2026 monthly capacity of 2 million VPC and 3.5 million MEMS probe needles, targeting 2.5 million and 6 million respectively by end-2027. Insertion 3 CPO engineering tools have reached three customers, while the first Insertion 2 qualification outcome is expected in December. Capacity targets, production orders and guidance for at least 50% revenue growth in 2027 remain prospective.

label.zh: 探針卡與 CPO 測試供應鏈

text.zh: VPC、MEMS 探針卡用於半導體晶圓與晶粒的電性測試，CPO 設備則涉及光電零件組裝、光學對準與測試。不同產品的產能單位及客戶認證時間不可混合。
text.en: VPC and MEMS probe cards serve electrical wafer and die tests, while CPO tools are used for photonic assembly, alignment and test. Probe-needle capacity and CPO equipment acceptance are separate measures.

text.zh: 公司於 11 月 16 日法說提出 2026 年底 VPC 月產能 200 萬針、MEMS 350 萬針的目標，並預計 2027 年底分別達 250 萬與 600 萬針。當前數值為期末規劃，並未全部提供當日實際稼動或良率。
text.en: Management cited planned year-end 2026 VPC capacity of 2.0 million and MEMS capacity of 3.5 million needles a month, with 2027 targets of 2.5 million and 6.0 million. These period-end targets do not establish actual utilization or yields on November 16.

text.zh: 旺矽表示 Insertion 3 工程機已交予 3 家客戶，另有 3 家待交付；Insertion 2 預期 12 月取得首家客戶認證結果。兩款設備報導的單價約 100 萬美元，仍須逐件確認量產驗收、出貨與收入認列。
text.en: WinWay said Insertion 3 engineering systems had been delivered to three customers and three more were planned. The first Insertion 2 customer qualification result is due in December. Reported unit pricing is approximately US$1 million, but qualified production deliveries and recognized sales are unverified.

text.zh: 2027 年月產能實際上線日、探針良率、CPO 最終驗收台數與已簽量產採購合約仍未公開。
text.en: Actual 2027 capacity commissioning, needle yield, CPO final acceptance counts and binding production orders have not been disclosed.

title.zh: 台積電供應鏈管理論壇公布 35 家優良供應商，新增先進封測量產支援獎項
title.en: TSMC names 35 top suppliers and adds advanced packaging production-support award

summary.zh: 台積電 11 月 17 日舉辦 2026 年供應鏈管理論壇並發布 35 家優良供應商名單，涵蓋半導體設備、材料、晶圓廠建設、廠務、資訊服務及先進封測。官方列出矽品獲先進封測量產支援、漢唐獲全球化支援、萬潤獲量產支援等獎項；獲獎本身不代表新增採購訂單或供應商營收。
summary.en: TSMC held its 2026 Supply Chain Management Forum on November 17 and named 35 Excellent Performance Award recipients spanning equipment, materials, fab construction, facilities, IT and packaging. Its official list includes Siliconware for advanced packaging production support, United Integrated Services for globalization support and All Ring Tech for production support. Awards are not evidence of new purchase orders or supplier revenue.

text.zh: 台積電公告名單包含 ASML、應用材料、愛德萬測試、東京威力科創及多家台灣設備、材料、工廠自動化與工程業者。今年評選更加重視建廠安全、永續、全球支援及在地化合作。
text.en: Recipients include ASML, Applied Materials, Advantest, Tokyo Electron and Taiwanese suppliers covering equipment, materials, automation and fab construction. TSMC emphasized construction safety, sustainability, globalization support and localization.

text.zh: 台積電官方公告矽品精密獲卓越先進封測量產支援、漢唐獲卓越全球化支援、萬潤獲卓越量產支援，和碩則獲卓越資訊服務。新聞媒體統計今年 35 家，較去年 30 家增加 5 家，但官方名單並未提供這些企業的個別設備出貨量。
text.en: TSMC's release names Siliconware Precision Industries for advanced packaging support, United Integrated Services for globalization, All Ring Tech for production support and Pegatron for IT service. Media count 35 recipients versus 30 last year, but tool shipments by recipient were not disclosed.

text.en: Contract values, fab-capacity changes and equipment acceptance associated with individual recipients are not disclosed. The organizer's release does not specify the forum venue.

title.zh: 大聯大 11 月 17 日表示記憶體占營收逾半，2027 年供需成長仍屬公司預期
title.en: WPG says memory exceeds half of sales and expects slower market growth in 2027

summary.zh: 大聯大 11 月 17 日線上法說表示，記憶體產品目前占集團營收超過 50%，經銷產品涵蓋晶片、模組及 SSD，但尚未涉入 HBM。公司認為 2027 年記憶體市場可持續成長、增速可能較 2026 年放緩；第三季稅後淨利 103.9 億元、季增 20.5% 為先前已公布的財報實績，不能將預測視為已成交價格。
summary.en: At a November 17 online briefing, WPG said memory products now represent more than 50% of group revenue, spanning chips, modules and SSDs but not HBM. Management expects memory-market growth to continue at a slower rate in 2027. Previously reported Q3 net profit was NT$10.39 billion, up 20.5% QoQ; market commentary does not establish executed contract prices.

text.zh: 大聯大代理記憶體晶片、模組及 SSD，涉及 DRAM、NAND 與下游伺服器和終端系統。公司稱除一家主要原廠外，已涵蓋台美日多家記憶體供應商；HBM 尚未納入其營業項目。
text.en: WPG distributes memory chips, modules and SSDs across DRAM, NAND, servers and downstream systems. It reports relationships with major suppliers in Taiwan, Japan and the United States, while stating it is not active in HBM.

text.zh: 第三季稅後淨利 103.9 億元，季增 20.5%、年增 226.9%；前三季稅後淨利 245.59 億元、年增 238.2%。這些是已發布的財務期間數字，11 月 17 日新增的是記憶體占比、供貨緊張原因及明年市場增長判斷。
text.en: Q3 net profit was NT$10.39 billion, up 20.5% QoQ and 226.9% YoY; nine-month profit was NT$24.559 billion, up 238.2% YoY. These are previously disclosed financial periods. November 17 added management commentary on memory mix, supply constraints and next year's growth.

text.zh: 公司提及主要記憶體製造商擴產，但設備交期與產能投產時程使短期供給調整受限。2027 年市場成長放緩屬管理層判斷，沒有具體同口徑位元供給量或合約價預測。
text.en: Management cited fab expansion and equipment lead times as constraints on short-term memory availability. Slower 2027 growth is company outlook without a comparable bit-supply forecast or executed contract-pricing series.

text.zh: 記憶體各品項營收、HBM 客戶代理安排、原廠配貨數量及已成交價格未公開。
text.en: Revenue by memory type, possible HBM distribution plans, allocated units and executed prices remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 神雲 SC26 展示 52U 液冷機櫃整合 96 顆 GPU，另展示兩相液冷概念驗證
title.en: MiTAC demonstrates 52U liquid-cooled rack with 96 GPUs and separate two-phase cooling PoC at SC26

summary.zh: 神達控股子公司神雲科技 11 月 17 日在美國芝加哥 SC26 展示 52U 高密度 AI 液冷機櫃，配置 12 台 G4826Z5 伺服器及 96 顆 AMD MI355X GPU，並與 ZutaCore 展示無水兩相直接液冷概念驗證。公司另介紹規劃中的 44OU Helion 機櫃，所列處理器核心數為設計目標，未公布正式商業出貨或客戶驗收量。
summary.en: MiTAC Computing unveiled a 52U liquid-cooled AI rack at SC26 in Chicago on November 17, integrating 12 G4826Z5 servers and 96 AMD MI355X GPUs, alongside a separate two-phase direct-liquid-cooling proof of concept with ZutaCore. It also described a proposed 44OU Helion rack design; the projected core count is a design target, not accepted commercial shipments.

label.zh: 伺服器整機及供電散熱
label.en: Server systems, power and cooling context

text.zh: 52U 系統整合多台伺服器及 GPU，機櫃液冷與供電需要配合晶片熱功耗、管路、CDU 及電源分配。神雲發布的 12 台伺服器、96 顆 GPU 為展示配置，沒有附上對應的已交付客戶清單或額定機櫃輸入功率。
text.en: The 52U rack integrates multiple servers and GPUs, with liquid cooling and power distribution designed around chip heat load, plumbing and CDU systems. The 12-server, 96-GPU configuration is a demonstration rather than a disclosed customer delivery or rack input-power rating.

text.zh: 神雲與 ZutaCore 公布無水兩相直接液冷 PoC；廠商說明液體在晶片處汽化以搬運熱量，並提出 4,000W 以上散熱設計與 250W/cm² 熱通量的規格宣稱。這些屬設計或展示條件，仍需核對量測工況。
text.en: MiTAC and ZutaCore presented a waterless two-phase direct-liquid-cooling PoC. The announcement cites thermal-design support above 4,000W and heat flux above 250W/cm² under its stated design approach, without enough measured operating conditions for independent system-level comparison.

text.zh: 與 AMD 合作的 Helion ORv3 44OU 方案屬即將推出的設計，公告最多 32,768 個 Zen 6 CPU 核心為可擴充的架構目標；與現場 52U GPU 機櫃為不同產品。
text.en: The AMD collaboration on a proposed ORv3 44OU Helion platform cites scalability to 32,768 Zen 6 CPU cores. This is a future architecture target and not the same as the demonstrated 52U GPU rack.

text.zh: 液冷系統各工況實測、整櫃輸入功率、客戶量產驗收及已出貨機櫃數量尚未公開。
text.en: Measured cooling operating conditions, rack input power, customer production acceptance and shipped rack counts are not disclosed.

title.zh: 慧榮 SC26 展示 PCIe Gen6 企業級 SSD 控制器，宣稱最高 28GB/s 與逾 512TB 支援容量
title.en: Silicon Motion showcases PCIe Gen6 enterprise SSD controller with claimed 28GB/s and over 512TB support

summary.zh: 慧榮科技 11 月 17 日宣布於芝加哥 SC26 展示 MonTitan 企業級 SSD 控制器與參考平台，SM8466 PCIe Gen6 規格宣稱最高 28GB/s 循序傳輸、700 萬 IOPS 隨機效能及支援超過 512TB SSD 容量。這些是公司產品規格與展示內容，尚未披露客戶大量出貨、實測工作負載和同口徑競品測試數據。
summary.en: Silicon Motion announced on November 17 that it was exhibiting MonTitan enterprise SSD controllers and reference platforms at SC26 in Chicago. It states that its PCIe Gen6 SM8466 supports up to 28GB/s sequential throughput, seven million random IOPS and SSD capacities above 512TB. These are vendor specifications, not independently measured customer workloads or production shipments.

label.zh: 記憶體與資料中心儲存鏈

text.zh: 企業級 SSD 控制晶片結合 NAND 記憶體、主機 PCIe 介面、韌體與伺服器儲存架構。慧榮的 SM8366 屬 PCIe Gen5 參考設計，SM8466 則標示為 Gen6，兩者規格與量產階段應分開閱讀。
text.en: Enterprise SSD controllers connect NAND flash, host PCIe interfaces, firmware and server storage. The SM8366 is a PCIe Gen5 reference design; the SM8466 is the stated Gen6 product. Product generations and readiness levels differ.

text.zh: 慧榮稱 SM8366 搭配 QLC NAND 的參考設計最高支援 256TB，SM8466 的設計容量超過 512TB、循序速度最高 28GB/s、隨機效能最高 700 萬 IOPS。以上是公司規格上限，沒有提供標準化的測試條件、溫度及功耗數據。
text.en: Silicon Motion lists up to 256TB with QLC NAND for SM8366, while SM8466 specifications exceed 512TB and quote up to 28GB/s sequential throughput and seven million IOPS. Standardized benchmark settings, temperature and power conditions were not included.

text.zh: 公司另展示 NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU 搭配的 PCIe NVMe 開機碟，以及搭配信驊 AST2600 BMC 的 Ferri-eMMC 嵌入式儲存；這些是系統整合展示，未證明已出貨至特定終端。
text.en: The release also describes NVMe boot storage paired with NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPUs and embedded Ferri-eMMC support involving ASPEED AST2600 BMC platforms. These are integration demonstrations without named customer deliveries.

text.zh: SM8466 正式量產時間、各容量配置的實測速度、功耗、客戶驗證及供應量尚未公布。
text.en: SM8466 mass-production timing, measured speed by capacity, power consumption, qualification and volume shipments are undisclosed.

title.zh: 康舒 SC26 展出水冷板 Power Shelf 與介電液冷 PSU，涵蓋 800V 供電架構
title.en: AcBel shows cold-plate Power Shelf and dielectric-liquid-cooled PSU at SC26, spanning 800V architecture

summary.zh: 康舒科技 11 月 16 日公布將於 11 月 17 至 19 日芝加哥 SC26 展示水冷板 Power Shelf 與和英國 Iceotope 合作的介電液體冷卻電源供應器。產品組合涵蓋 12V、50V、正負 400V 及 800V 電力架構；公司未公布本次展示機型的已簽採購金額、客戶驗收數量及可比較的實測效率。
summary.en: AcBel announced on November 16 that its November 17–19 SC26 exhibit in Chicago would feature a cold-plate Power Shelf and dielectric-liquid-cooled PSU developed with UK company Iceotope. The portfolio spans 12V, 50V, plus/minus 400V and 800V electrical architectures. The issuer did not disclose contracted values, accepted units or comparable measured efficiency for the showcased products.

text.zh: AI 機櫃供電包含 PSU、Power Shelf、BBU Shelf、側掛式電源與配電組件。康舒此展示將液冷延伸到電源產品，有別於只冷卻 GPU 的方案；展示的水冷板與介電液體兩種技術須依實際工況區分。
text.en: Rack electrical systems span PSUs, Power Shelves, backup shelves, sidecar supplies and distribution components. AcBel's exhibit extends liquid cooling to power hardware as well as compute components; cold-plate and dielectric-fluid approaches have different operating conditions.

text.zh: 康舒原廠公告展位為芝加哥 McCormick Place West 7006 號，11 月 17 至 19 日展示新液冷電源技術。公司表示相關產品涵蓋 800VDC 等架構，並稱先前曾交付其他液冷電源產品，但並未將歷史交付台數指向本次展示產品。
text.en: AcBel's company release names booth 7006 at McCormick Place West for November 17–19. Its broader range supports 800VDC among other architectures. Past liquid-cooled power deliveries cited by the company are not shipment counts for these specific exhibits.

text.zh: 公司引用 IEA 2026 年報告的功率密度歷史與未來預測，但本次並未揭露 Power Shelf 的實測冷卻液流量、出水溫度、額定負載或客戶驗證結果。外部產業推估不能代替該產品的實驗數據。
text.en: The company references an IEA assessment of server power-density trends but does not give measured coolant flow, outlet temperatures, rated load or acceptance test results for the showcased Power Shelf. Sector estimates do not substitute for product measurements.

text.zh: 展示設備型號的正式量產、額定效率、實測熱阻、客戶驗收與採購金額未公開。
text.en: Production qualification, rated efficiency, measured thermal resistance, customer acceptance and contracted value for the displayed systems are unknown.

name.zh: 康舒 · 11 月 16 日 SC26 公司新聞稿
SC26 · 主辦單位展期與場館

location.zh: 展覽場地：美國伊利諾州芝加哥 McCormick Place West，康舒攤位 7006；展示日期 11 月 17 至 19 日。
location.en: Exhibition venue: McCormick Place West, Chicago, Illinois, United States, AcBel booth 7006; November 17–19.

industries.zh: 電源；供電；液冷；散熱；伺服器；資料中心；零組件
industries.en: Power; electric distribution; liquid cooling; servers; data centers; components

chain.zh: PSU 與 Power Shelf 至機櫃供電、介電液冷及資料中心
chain.en: PSUs and Power Shelves through rack power, dielectric cooling and data centers

investment.zh: 沒有公開本次展示產品新增資本支出。
investment.en: No new capex for these display products was disclosed.

demand.zh: 展出方案及過往交付經驗屬不同資訊，沒有新的採購數量。
demand.en: Exhibited products and historical deliveries are distinct; no new order volume was reported.

relevance.zh: 液冷電源涉及電力轉換、功率控制與高功率密度機櫃散熱。
relevance.en: Liquid-cooled power hardware links conversion, controls and high-density rack thermals.

timing.zh: 11 月 16 日公司發布；11 月 17 至 19 日參展。

unknowns.zh: 正式客戶認證、功率與熱性能的可比較測試仍未提供。
unknowns.en: Comparable power/thermal tests and customer qualifications remain unavailable.

ceoView.zh: 對資料中心精密電源、功率量測與液冷控制供應商而言，展示同時涉及電力轉換與冷卻設備的整合介面。應核對 800VDC 安規、負載測試、流量與散熱效能及客戶驗收，在缺乏工況數據時不能推估實際採購需求。
ceoView.en: For precision data-center power, electrical metrology and cooling-control suppliers, the exhibit concerns power-conversion and coolant-system interfaces. The 800VDC safety envelope, load tests, flow, heat rejection and customer acceptance are unverified, preventing demand estimates.

question.zh: 美國新規是否等於東南亞所有 AI 資料中心都不能購入晶片？
question.en: Does the new U.S. rule prohibit all chip shipments to Southeast Asian data centers?

text.zh: 規則針對特定高階晶片目的地和受管制終端用途，對部分美國總部企業另列申報條件下的排除。正式生效日仍需以聯邦公報公布版本查核。
text.en: The provisions target defined chips and end uses, with a reporting-conditioned exclusion for some U.S.-headquartered users. The exact effective date still requires checking the Federal Register publication.

question.zh: 鴻海收購的金額是否包含 Sony 相關海外工廠設備？
question.en: Does Foxconn's consideration include all Sony overseas production equipment?

text.zh: 鴻海公告交易涉及特定車載相機模組事業資產；中央社指出部分海外設備及存貨不在目前對價內。是否追加收購及交割後產能尚未公布。
text.en: The agreement concerns specified camera-module business assets. CNA says certain offshore equipment and inventory are excluded; any additional acquisition and post-closing capacity remain unknown.

question.zh: 旺矽工程機交付是否代表 CPO 已完成量產驗收？
question.en: Do WinWay engineering-tool deliveries establish qualified CPO mass production?

text.zh: Insertion 3 工程機已送 3 家客戶，但 Insertion 2 首家客戶認證結果仍預定 12 月取得。工程樣機、客戶驗證與量產設備訂單是不同階段。
text.en: Three customers received Insertion 3 engineering systems, while the first Insertion 2 qualification result is still expected in December. Engineering samples, validation and production-tool orders are distinct stages.

title.zh: 過往東南亞資料中心與伺服器投資
title.en: Prior Southeast Asian data-center and server investment

text.zh: 11 月 17 日路透引述馬來西亞自 2021 年以來約 3,857 億令吉的資料中心累計核准投資。此數值屬過去核准累計，不能視為新法規發布後的投資變動。
text.en: Reuters cited RM385.7 billion of Malaysian data-center investment approvals since 2021 on November 17. This historical cumulative approval amount does not measure the new rule's investment effects.

title.zh: 股價新聞及既有擴廠評論
title.en: Share-price news and prior expansion commentary

text.zh: 股價跌幅、由既有精材先進封裝協議推導的未確認設備訂單，以及十月已公布的高階銅箔計畫，沒有新增可確認交付或合約，未作為新事件。
text.en: Stock-price changes, unverified tool orders inferred from Xintec's earlier agreement, and October copper-foil plans added no confirmed new delivery or contract and were not republished.

verificationNote.zh: 美國 BIS 11 月 16 日規則公開稿尚有生效日期占位欄，須以最終聯邦公報核定版本為準。鴻海收購金額為初始日圓對價，新台幣數字為媒體約當換算。旺矽 2027 年產能與 CPO 訂單為公司目標，SC26 展示規格未代表客戶量產驗收，台積電獲獎名單也不能代表新增採購。
verificationNote.en: The examined BIS rule draft retains an effective-date placeholder, requiring confirmation against the finalized Federal Register publication. Foxconn's contractual amount is initially denominated in yen, with NT dollars an approximate media conversion. WinWay's 2027 capacity and CPO orders are prospective; SC26 product specifications are not customer acceptance and supplier awards do not establish new purchases.
